curated.tagline: One secrets interface for Agent Zero, with masked values only
curated.description: One secrets interface for Agent Zero. Resolves keys through the OmaSeal keyring, 1Password, environment, or an encrypted vault; agents see names and masked values only.
highlights: Single resolution path across four secret backends
Keyring, 1Password, env, and encrypted vault support
curated.architecture: Agent request → secret resolver → backend (keyring/1Password/env/vault) → masked value
